<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920519_theRebbe_475__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the joy of Rosh Hashanah comes from drawing down a supernal light through judgment, and that the standing of all Israel ensures this light is drawn down.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is: “Let the field exult and all that is in it,”</t>
    <t s="2">meaning that through the judgment and justice of Rosh Hashanah, a most supernal light is drawn down.</t>
    <t s="3">And this is also what they said in the Midrash,</t>
    <t s="4">brought in the Tur, Laws of Rosh Hashanah:</t>
    <t s="5">“This nation knows the character of its God—</t>
    <t s="6">for all the nations wrap themselves in black and wear black,</t>
    <t s="7">but Israel wears white and wraps themselves in white,</t>
    <t s="8">because they know that the Holy One, blessed be He, will perform a miracle for them.”</t>
    <t s="9">For at first glance it is not understood: what is the joy of wearing white?</t>
    <t s="10">For even though they know that He will perform a miracle for them,</t>
    <t s="11">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="12">would it not be better that there be no judgment at all?</t>
    <t s="13">But the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="14">that the judgment of Rosh Hashanah is for the sake of drawing down a more supernal light,</t>
    <t s="15">and therefore there is joy.</t>
    <t s="16">And this is what is meant by “He will perform a miracle for them,”</t>
    <t s="17">for a miracle is above nature,</t>
    <t s="18">meaning a light that is above the chain of descent (hishtalshelus).</t>
    <t s="19">For “this day is the beginning of Your works,”</t>
    <t s="20">for Malchus is included in the aspect of “the King elevated alone from then,”</t>
    <t s="21">the aspect of His Name in the aspect of “He alone is He,”</t>
    <t s="22">and from there one must draw down.</t>
    <t s="23">However, since a most supernal light is drawn down,</t>
    <t s="24">there are accusers that the light should not be drawn down,</t>
    <t s="25">therefore He says,</t>
    <t s="26">“You are standing today, all of you, before Havayah,”</t>
    <t s="27">meaning all the levels within the souls of Israel—</t>
    <t s="28">“your heads, your tribes,” etc., meaning those of comprehension whose service is in the manner of the service of the Seraphim,</t>
    <t s="29">“from the hewer of your wood to the drawer of your water,” whose service is in acceptance of the yoke in the manner of the service of the Ofanim—</t>
    <t s="30">behold, all the levels stand firm and endure and prevail in judgment,</t>
    <t s="31">so that the supernal light will be drawn down to them,</t>
    <t s="32">“before Havayah,”</t>
    <t s="33">above the level of the Name Havayah,</t>
    <t s="34">and this is drawn down below, down into this world, in all the matters of the judgment and justice of Rosh Hashanah,</t>
    <t s="35">that there should be a healthy year, a living year, and a joyful year in all particulars,</t>
    <t s="36">and in children, life, and sustenance in abundance.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
